panels.description: The Measure connects the analog gauge to the official data line. Blue-white lines cross between both readings. Leave upper machinery space.
The readout displays the same rolling thirty-day period and conflicting percentages. Leave upper display space.
Ada and Alex study the readout together. Leave upper chamber space.
The Measure traces the missing flow through the broad industrial uplink toward Halyard. Leave upper pipe space.
